articles.title: Expanded Maritime Security Cooperation under India-ASEAN Strategic Partnership
articles.summary: India and ASEAN strengthen joint maritime domain awareness and counter-piracy operations across the Indo-Pacific region.
prelims: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) outlines sovereign rights in Exclusive Economic Zones (EEZ).
India's SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision anchors its Indo-Pacific strategy.
The Malacca Strait serves as a strategic maritime chokepoint between the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea.
articles.mains: Use in answers evaluating India's Act East Policy, Indo-Pacific geopolitical dynamics, and regional security frameworks.

articles.title: RBI Expands CBDC-UPI Interoperability Framework for Offline Retail Payments
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India introduces offline transaction capabilities for the Digital Rupee to boost financial inclusion in remote regions.
prelims: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) is sovereign currency issued in digital form by the RBI.
CBDC is categorized into Retail (CBDC-R) for general public and Wholesale (CBDC-W) for financial institutions.
Unlike decentralized cryptocurrencies, CBDC represents direct liability of the central bank.
articles.mains: Useful for analyzing Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), monetary policy transmission, and financial technology innovations in India.

articles.title: National Carbon Farming Framework Launched to Enhance Soil Organic Carbon
articles.summary: Ministry of Agriculture introduces standardized guidelines for carbon credit generation through regenerative agricultural practices.
prelims: Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) is a critical indicator of soil health and agricultural productivity.
Regenerative agriculture emphasizes minimal soil disturbance, cover cropping, and crop rotation.
Carbon farming monetizes carbon sequestration activities carried out by agricultural landholders.
articles.mains: Ideal for questions regarding climate-resilient agriculture, sustainable farm income, and climate change mitigation strategies.

articles.title: Universal Health Interface Integration under Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission
articles.summary: National Health Authority expands open-protocol infrastructure to enable seamless teleconsultation and access to health records nationwide.
prelims: National Health Authority (NHA) is the apex body responsible for implementing ABDM.
ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) assigns a 14-digit unique health identification number to citizens.
Universal Health Interface (UHI) operates on open network standards similar to UPI for healthcare services.
articles.mains: Use in answers examining digital health interventions, governance in public healthcare, and achieving Universal Health Coverage.

articles.title: ISRO Upgrades Deep Space Network Infrastructure for Venus Orbiter Mission
articles.summary: ISRO enhances communication antennas at the Indian Deep Space Network to support upcoming planetary exploration missions.
prelims: The Venus Orbiter Mission (Shukrayaan) is designed to study the atmosphere and surface radar imagery of Venus.
Indian Deep Space Network (IDSN) is located at Byalalu, near Bengaluru, Karnataka.
Venus has a high-density atmosphere dominated primarily by carbon dioxide and thick clouds of sulfuric acid.
articles.mains: Valuable for questions on India's indigenous space technology achievements, deep-space communication capabilities, and scientific research.
